scope: Same 38 configured managed roots; full host recorded separately

installedLoads.note: Observed loads include startup-hook and test-runner dependencies, not just test bodies.

limits: Single cold observations, not medians. Acquisition and declaration generation excluded.
Raw restore is measured separately and visits authored frameworks without forcing a root framework into tooling.
Full host uses one worker; matched managed comparison uses two workers/two MSBuild nodes.
Raw binlog framework metadata is incomplete; the same 253 project paths compiled on both sides.
Execution logs and profiles are written during timing.
Stopped exploratory Bazel managed runs and failed forced-framework raw restore are excluded.
Private VM HTTP network; no remote execution or native x64 qualification.
